Paragraph: "Oh! great discerner Sugreeva, this is Rama... oh, stubbornly valiant Sugreeva, this virtuously valiant Rama arrived along with his brother Lakshmana...
Situation/Problem_Faced: Introducing powerful and unknown entities to the leader.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman highlights the noble character and valor of the arriving princes.
Outcome/Resolution: Prepares Sugreeva to receive the guests with proper respect.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Self-Esteem: Affirming the high caliber and dignity of the guests

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Highlighting the inherent nobility (guna) of divine souls to dispel doubt.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Building positive expectations and reducing apprehension through affirmative introduction.
